# FNLLA Core Code of Conduct

FNLLA Core is maintained as a professional open-source project by TechAyo LTD.
Everyone participating in issues, pull requests, reviews or community spaces is
expected to communicate clearly, respectfully and in good faith.

## Expected behaviour

- keep feedback specific, actionable and respectful
- protect private, client and security-sensitive information
- respect the Core boundary, licensing and maintainer decisions
- disclose conflicts of interest and third-party intellectual-property concerns
- report risk and uncertainty honestly

## Unacceptable behaviour

- harassment, discrimination, intimidation or personal attacks
- publishing private or security-sensitive information without authorisation
- deliberate disruption of releases, provenance or repository integrity
- misrepresenting FNLLA, FNLLA Core, TechAyo or their licensing

## Enforcement and reporting

Maintainers may edit or remove content, close discussions, reject contributions
or restrict participation when conduct creates community, legal, delivery or
security risk. Report conduct concerns privately through
[TechAyo](https://techayo.co.uk) with the subject `FNLLA CORE CONDUCT`.

Security vulnerabilities must follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), never a
public conduct report or issue.
